thesis.thesis: HISTORICAL PRELIMINARY RESEARCH RECORD — NOT A LIVE INVESTMENT RECOMMENDATION AND NOT A RANKING. This entry records only that Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. (AMD) cleared a narrow, frozen, disclosure-only screen applied to its Q3 2024 SEC filing. The screen's sole criteria were reported GAAP gross margin >= 40% and reported revenue year-over-year >= 0%; the live seven-factor market-data completeness gate was explicitly not applied (require_complete=false). Per the frozen offline adapter, AMD was retained: GAAP revenue USD 6,819 million, revenue +18% YoY, GAAP gross margin 50% for the period ended Q3 2024, filed 2024-10-29. No rejected candidates were returned in this single-symbol run. Passing this screen establishes only that two reported accounting metrics met two thresholds on one historical filing date; it says nothing about share price, valuation, expected return, or relative attractiveness, and the source dates of this fixture differ and must not be treated as a contemporaneous cross-issuer ranking. The thesis remains at the 'researching' stage precisely because the price/valuation dimension is absent from the evidence set.

Revenue YoY of +18% and GAAP gross margin of 50% are as reported for the Q3 2024 period and are not restated or independently recomputed here.
The frozen offline adapter's two-criteria rule (GAAP gross margin >= 40%, revenue YoY >= 0%) is the only selection logic applied; no market-data completeness gate was used.
No share price, valuation multiple, analyst target, or forward-return input exists in this evidence set, so no valuation conclusion can be drawn.
catalysts: Future disclosure of a subsequent quarterly filing that would allow the same two reported metrics to be re-tested on a newer period.
Future availability of price and valuation data, which would be required before any valuation view could be formed.
invalidations: A later filing restating Q3 2024 GAAP gross margin below 40% or revenue YoY below 0% would invalidate the screen-pass basis of this record.
Evidence that the cited source URL or SHA-256 does not correspond to the Q3 2024 filing would invalidate the evidence basis.
